Multi-turn conversation with system, user, assistant, and follow-up user messages

```swift title="Swift"
import Foundation
import LiterLlm

let _req = try LiterLlm.chatCompletionRequestFromJson("{\"messages\":[{\"content\":\"You are a helpful assistant.\",\"role\":\"system\"},{\"content\":\"What is 2 + 2?\",\"role\":\"user\"},{\"content\":\"2 + 2 equals 4.\",\"role\":\"assistant\"},{\"content\":\"And what is 4 + 4?\",\"role\":\"user\"}],\"model\":\"gpt-4\"}")
guard let _apiKey = ProcessInfo.processInfo.environment["API_KEY"] else { fatalError("API_KEY must be set") }
let _client = try createClient(apiKey: _apiKey, baseUrl: nil)
let result = try await _client.chat(_req)
debugPrint(result.choices())
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].message().content() as Any)
debugPrint(result.choices()[0].finishReason() as Any)
```
